lines.text: My speech got a standing ovation!
I nailed it! The teacher clapped.

data.define: Used when you did something exactly right.

example.text: I nailed it! The teacher clapped.

misuse.text: Don't say 'nailed it' after you failed.

hook.text: My speech got a standing ovation!

publish.title: What does "nailed it" mean?
publish.value: Nailed it = I did it perfectly. Example: "I nailed it! The teacher clapped." (casual English).
